advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Sefa mazuva emakadhi ne @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt kana @listEnteredAt. Muenzaniso: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' kana @endAt = none. Isa zita remunda wawakagadzira rinotanga ne @ muzviratidzo zvekutaura.
advanced-filter-description: zvepamusoro sefa allows ku write a string containing following operators: == != <= >= && || ( ) A space iri used as a separator between the Operators. unogona sefa for zvose Custom ndima na typing their names uye values. For Example: Field1 == Value1. Note: If ndima kana values contains spaces, you need ku encapsulate them into single quotes. For Example: 'ndima 1' == 'ukoshi 1'. For single control characters (' \/) ku iva skipped, unogona use \. For example: Field1 == I\'m. Also unogona combine multiple conditions. For Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally zvose operators vari interpreted kubva left ku right. unogona chinja the order na placing brackets. For Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also unogona tsvaga mashoko ndima using regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Tsiva pose panowanikwa mavara mukati memamwe mavara.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: bvisa nzvimbo dzisina mavara kumativi ose e
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_LEFT: bvisa nzvimbo dzisina mavara kuruboshwe kwe
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_RIGHT: bvisa nzvimbo dzisina mavara kurudyi kwe
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Dzorera kopi yemavara yabviswa nzvimbo dzisina mavara kune rimwe kana kumativi ose.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Inoisa chinotsiviwa nemashoko ichi kuti chienzane nezvinopinzwa.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS: Chinotsiviwa nemashoko chine zita rekuti '%1' chatovapo.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Chinotsiviwa nemashoko chine zita rekuti '%1' chatovapo cherumwe rudzi: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Chinotsiviwa nemashoko chine zita rekuti '%1' chatovapo sechinopinzwa mubasa rekodhi '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Tsvaga munzvimbo yekushandira. Dzvanya Enter kuenda kune chinotevera chinoenderana, Shift+Enter kune chakapfuura chinoenderana. Dzvanya Escape kuvhara kutsvaga uye kutarisa chinoenderana chazvino.
bots-none: Hapana mabhoti parizvino. Bhoti ichimhanyisi pasevha yako - mumiriri weAI, basa reCI, script - iro bhodhi rino rinopa makadhi.
card-archive-pop: kadhi will kwete iva visible pa this rondedzero mushure archiving kadhi.
card-archive-suggest-cancel: unogona later dzorera kadhi kubva dura.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ndeye SuperAdmin chete, pa domeni re Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Ne WeKan mu Weddy, Cloud Panel inoshandira madomeni mazhinji e WeKan kubva pasevha imwe, rimwe nerimwe rine data raro. Pa domeni re Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin anotonga madomeni ne CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ne kiyi ye CloudFlare API, domeni ine zone iri muakaundi yako ye CloudFlare inowana rekodhi ye DNS inopfuura ne proxy uye chitupa che CloudFlare Origin. Mamwe madomeni anowana chitupa che Let's Encrypt. Kiyi inochengetwa pasevha uye haichazombofa yakaratidzwa.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Hapana kiyi ye CloudFlare API yakachengetwa: domeni yega yega inowana chitupa che Let's Encrypt.
confirm-checklist-delete-popup: une chokwadi here you want ku dzima the rondedzero yekuongorora?
confirm-checklist-item-delete-popup: une chokwadi here you want ku dzima the rondedzero yekuongorora item?
creator: Mugadziri
csv-mapping-boards: Peji rega rega rinova bhodhi raro:
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Mamwe makoramu ekupinza seminda yakagadzirwa yemavara:
csv-mapping-description: Sarudza koramu yefaira ine munda wega wega wekadhi. Sarudzo dzakaitwa kubva pamazita emakoramu; shandura dzisiri dzo, uye sarudza (haisi mufaira) pamunda usipo mufaira.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Faira harina koramu yerondedzero. Sarudza imwe pamusoro apa, kana nyora zita rerondedzero imwe chete inopinda makadhi ese.
csv-mapping-list-required: Nyora zita rerondedzero inopinda makadhi ese, kana sarudza koramu ine rondedzero.
delete-all-notifications-confirm: une chokwadi here you want ku dzima zvose zviziviso? This chiito haagoni iva undone.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kutumirwa hakuna kukwanisa kusimbiswa; ongorora usati waedzazve
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Mugamuchiri haawanikwi kana akaundi yakadzimwa kushanda
email-invite-register-text:
Dear __user__,

__inviter__ invites you ku kanban bhodhi for collaborations.

Please follow the link below:
__url__

uye yako invitation code iri: __icode__

Thanks.
email-recovery-busy: Kutumira kana chimwe chiito pamutsara chiri kuitwa. Rodhazve woedzazve munguva pfupi.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Kanzura mashoko ose akamirira kutumirwa kumugamuchiri uyu pari zvino? Zviri maari zvichabviswa uye hazvigoni kudzorerwa. Mashoko matsva agadzirwa mushure mechikumbiro ichi anochengetwa.
email-recovery-description: Mutsara mumwe pamugamuchiri. Tsvaga neID yemushandisi. Zviri mumashoko nenzvimbo dzetsamba dzemagetsi dzevagamuchiri hazviratidzwi. Kumbomisa kunobata mashoko aripo neachauya; kuenderera kunoedzazve mashoko akamirira iye zvino. Kukanzura kunobvisa mashoko akaiswa mumutsara kusvika panguva yechikumbiro. Kana kutumira kuchiri kuitwa, edzazve munguva pfupi. Mashoko ari kutotumirwa haagoni kudzoserwa, uye kutumira kusina chokwadi kunogona kudzokororwa. Kukundikana kwechigarire nekusvika pamuganhu wekuedzazve zvinoramba zviripo kuti zviongororwe. Kuedzazve mashoko akundikana kunotanga denderedzwa idzva rekuedza uye kunoremekedza kumbomiswa kuripo.
email-recovery-empty: Hapana mashoko akamirira kana vagamuchiri vakambomiswa.
email-recovery-failed: Chiito hachina kukwanisa kusimbiswa. Rodhazve mutsara woedzazve chiito ichocho kana zvichidiwa.
email-recovery-superseded: Chiito chitsva chemushandisi anotarisira chatsiva chikumbiro ichi. Mamiriro emutsara azvino ndiwo ari kuratidzwa.
email-recovery-unavailable: Hazvigoni kuverenga mutsara wetsamba dzemagetsi. Tarisa mvumo yemutarisiri nekuwanika kwesevha.
email-resetPassword-text:
Hello __user__,

ku dzorera yako pasiwedhi, simply click the link below.

__url__

Thanks.
email-verifyEmail-text:
Hello __user__,

ku verify yako akaundi email, simply click the link below.

__url__

Thanks.
error-json-malformed: yako mashoko iri kwete valid JSON
error-json-schema: yako JSON data does kwete include the proper ruzivo mu the correct format
error-ldap-login: An kukanganisa occurred while trying ku login
error-notAuthorized: You vari kwete authorized ku view this peji.
error-username-taken: This zita remushandisi iri already taken
export-card-details: kadhi details (each kadhi as mu kadhi tumira kunze)
filter-on-desc: You vari filtering makadhi pa bhodhi iri. baya pano ku gadzirisa sefa.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Zvakatumirwa kunze zvinodudza mazita ezvakabatanidzwa asi hazvitakure mafaira. Kuti uauye nawo, ipa kero yesevhisi nekupinda: zvinoshandiswa pakupinza uku chete, zvinotumirwa kukero iyoyo chete, uye hazvimbochengetwi. Siya pasina chinhu kuti upinze usina mafaira.
import-attachment-auth-token: Tokeni yeAPI, kiyi yeAPI kana pasiwedhi yeapp
import-board-instruction-asana: Paste an Asana tasks tumira kunze JSON ({ "data": [...] } kubva the Asana tumira kunze kana GET /tasks). Tasks vari grouped into sections (memberships); zvapedzwa tasks go ku Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: MuBusinessmap (yaimbova Kanbanize), vhura Advanced Search, sarudza Configure results kuti usarudze makoramu, tora faira reExcel, wozosarudza faira re.xlsx iroro. Makoramu anoverengwa nemazita awo echiRungu (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): kana akaundi yako ichishandisa mumwe mutauro, tanga washandura mutsara wemisoro kuchiRungu. Column inova marondedzero uye Lane migwagwa; varidzi, matagi, ruvara, mazuva, mhinduro nezvinongedzo zvikuru zvinoramba zviri munzvimbo dzazvo, uye Priority, Size, Type nemamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-clickup: MuClickUp, budisa mabasa seCSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kana kubudisa kwechiratidziro cheList kana Table nemakoramu ese), wozoisa CSV. Mamiriro anova marondedzero, marondedzero eClickUp anova migwagwa, uye mabasa anova makadhi ane mabasa madiki, vapiwa basa, matagi, mazuva, kukosha nenguva.
import-board-instruction-csv: Paste mu yako Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) .
import-board-instruction-deck: Paste a NextCloud Deck bhodhi JSON (a bhodhi ne "stacks", each stack carrying its "cards"). Stacks become rondedzero uye makadhi become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-excel: sarudza a WeKan-style .xlsx spreadsheet (the zvimwe chete columns as the Excel tumira kunze: musoro, tsananguro, mamiriro/rondedzero, nhengo, zviratidzo, dates, custom ndima). The yekutanga row iri the header.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Vhura faira re-.boardarchive kubva mudura rakadzvanywa wonamira zviri mu-board.jsonl yebhodhi, nemutsara weshanduro kana pasina iwo. Chimiro chekuisa mumapoka pakuonekwa kwebhodhi chinova rondedzero, zvimwe zvimiro zvekusarudza zvinova mareberu, zvikamu zvemashoko nemabhokisi ekumaka zvinova tsananguro nerondedzero yekuongorora, uye mhinduro dzinochengetwa. Mifananidzo nemafaira akabatanidzwa hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Paste a __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become makadhi grouped into vhura / Closed rondedzero.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Paste a Kanboard tumira kunze JSON: an object ne "columns" (kana tasks carrying column_name) uye a "tasks" array (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns become rondedzero uye tasks become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: MuKanri, vhura Import & Export usarudze Export individual board (kana Export all data), wozoisa faira re.json. Makoramu anova marondedzero uye makadhi anova makadhi, ane tsanangudzo, zuva rekupedzisira, matagi nemavara awo; mabasa ekadhi anova rondedzero yekuongorora. Pakubudisa data rese, bhodhi rekutanga ndiro rinopinzwa.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namira rondedzero ine zvikamu zveLeo (faira re.leo). Zvikamu zvepamusoro zvinova rondedzero, zvikamu zviri pasi pazvo zvinova makadhi ane zviri muchikamu setsananguro, uye zvikamu zvakadzika zvinova rondedzero dzekutarisa. Zvikamu zvakamakiwa zvinopinzwa sezvakapera.
import-board-instruction-linear: MuLinear, budisa nyaya seCSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kana kubudisa kwechiratidziro), wozoisa CSV. Mamiriro anova marondedzero, zvikwata zvinova migwagwa, uye nyaya dzinova makadhi ane wapiwa basa, mareberu, mazuva, nyaya huru, kukosha, fungidziro, purojekiti nedenderedzwa.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namira runyorwa rwemabasa emarkdown (tsika inoshandiswa nemidziyo yemarkdown-kanban seObsidian Kanban): misoro ye"## Zita rerunyorwa", ine zvinhu "- [ ]"/"- [x]" pasi payo. Misoro inova runyorwa uye zvinhu zvinova makadhi.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: MuMeisterTask, dzvanya zita repurojekiti, sarudza Export project wobva wabudisa CSV, wozoiisa pano. Zvikamu zvinova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane zvinyorwa zvawo, zuva rekupedzisira, wapiwa basa nematagi; mabasa akapedzwa anochengeta zuva rawakapedzwa. CSV yakanyorerwa kupinza kweMeisterTask pachayo inoshandawo.
import-board-instruction-monday: Mumonday.com, vhura menyu yebhodhi, sarudza More actions neExport board to Excel (nezvigadziriso nezvinhu zvidiki kana uchida), wozosarudza faira re.xlsx iroro. Koramu yeStatus inova marondedzero uye mapoka anova migwagwa; vanhu, mazuva, nguva nematagi zvinoramba zviri munzvimbo dzazvo, mamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa uye zvigadziriso zvinova mhinduro.
import-board-instruction-notion: MuNotion, vhura dhatabhesi sepeji rizere, sarudza ••• neExport, sarudza Markdown & CSV, wosarudza faira re.zip rinotorwa, kana CSV imwe yedhatabhesi iri mariri, kana isa CSV iyoyo. Koramu inonzi Status inova marondedzero (kana isipo, koramu yekutanga inoita sesarudzo ndiyo inoshandiswa, uye mushumo wekupinza unotaura kuti ndeipi); mitsara inova makadhi ane musoro, matagi semareberu, vanhu senhengo, mazuva, nemavara epeji setsanangudzo; mamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa. Hukama, mifananidzo nezvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: MuNullboard, vhura bhodhi, sarudza Export this board... pamenyu, vhura faira re.nbx mumugadziri wemavara woisa zviri mukati maro. Marondedzero anova marondedzero uye zvinyorwa zvinova makadhi: mutsara wekutanga wechinyorwa ndiwo musoro wekadhi uye zvakasara itsanangudzo yaro. Chinyorwa chisina kugadziriswa chinowana reberu raw. Faira rine mabhodhi akati wandei rinopinza bhodhi raro rekutanga.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: MuObsidian, vhura faira rebhodhi reKanban seMarkdown (kana vhura faira re.md mumugadziri wemavara), wozoisa zvese zviri mariri. Migwagwa inova marondedzero ane miganhu yemakadhi, makadhi anochengeta matagi, mazuva, kukosha, minda nerondedzero yekuongorora, uye Archive inova makadhi ari mudura.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Paste an OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses become rondedzero uye work packages become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Isa rondedzero yeOPML, sezvinoibudisa Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq nezvimwe zvirongwa zvemarondedzero. Zvinhu zvepamusoro-soro zvinova marondedzero, vana vazvo vanova makadhi ane chinyorwa setsanangudzo, uye zvinhu zvakadzika zvinova marondedzero ekuongorora. Zvinhu zvakapedzwa zvinopinzwa sezvakaitwa.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Isa faira reOrg mode, sezvarinonyorwa neEmacs, Orgzly kana Beorg. Misoro yepamusoro-soro inova marondedzero uye misoro yechipiri inova makadhi. TODO ne DONE, kukosha, matagi, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ne CLOSED zvinochengetwa, uye mabhokisi ekuongorora nemisoro yakadzika zvinova marondedzero ekuongorora.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: MuPivotal Tracker, vhura tebhu yeMORE yepurojekiti usarudze Export CSV (kana sarudza nyaya wosarudza Bulk Actions, CSV), wozoisa CSV. Mamiriro ega ega enyaya anova rondedzero uye nyaya dzinova makadhi, ane rudzi nemareberu, varidzi, akakumbira, mazuva, mhinduro, mabasa nezvipingamupinyi; Estimate inova Story points uye madenderedzwa anova nguva pfupi dzebasa.
import-board-instruction-plane: MuPlane, vhura Workspace Settings, sarudza Exports, budisa mapurojekiti seJSON, CSV kana Excel wotora faira re.zip, wozosarudza faira iroro, kana faira rimwe riri mukati maro, kana isa JSON kana CSV. Mamiriro anova marondedzero, mapurojekiti anova migwagwa, uye nyaya dzinova makadhi ane chiziviso, nyaya huru, vapiwa basa, mareberu, mazuva, zvinongedzo nemhinduro; kukosha, fungidziro, denderedzwa nechikamu zvinova minda yakagadzirwa. Kubudisa kwePlane hakuna tsanangudzo kana zvakabatanidzwa, saka hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: MuQuire, vhura menyu yepurojekiti usarudze Export CSV, wozoisa CSV. Mamiriro anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane mabasa madiki semakadhi evana, vapiwa basa, matagi semareberu, mazuva ekutanga, ekupedzisira nekupedzwa, tsanangudzo nekukosha semunda wakagadzirwa. Mhinduro nezvakabatanidzwa hazvisi muCSV yeQuire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: MuRedmine, vhura Issues yepurojekiti, sarudza Also available in: CSV pasi perondedzero, sarudza makoramu (All columns, neDescription) wobudisa, wozoisa CSV. Redmine inopa makoramu mazita mumutauro wako, saka isa mutauro wako kuchiRungu muMy account usati wabudisa. Mamiriro ega ega anova rondedzero uye nyaya dzinova makadhi, ane tracker sereberu, wapiwa basa, munyori, mazuva, basa guru nenyaya dzine hukama; kukosha, chikamu, shanduro inotarisirwa, nguva inofungidzirwa, % Done neminda yakagadzirwa zvinova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: MuSuper Productivity, vhura Settings, wozoita Sync & Backup, sarudza Export Data woisa zviri mufaira re sp-backup .json. Purojekiti yega yega inova mugwagwa uye mabasa anova makadhi muTo Do, In Progress, Backlog kana Done, ane zvinyorwa, matagi, zuva rekupedzisira, nguva yakashandiswa nemabasa madiki; mabasa ari mudura anova makadhi ari mudura.
import-board-instruction-taiga: MuTaiga, vhura Admin > Project > Export wotora dump yepurojekiti (tanga wavhura faira re.json.gz), wozoisa JSON yayo. Mamiriro enyaya dzevashandisi anova marondedzero, nyaya dzevashandisi dzinova makadhi ane mabasa awo semabasa madiki, maepiki nenyaya zvinowana migwagwa yazvo, uye nguva pfupi dzebasa, matagi, mhinduro nezvimiro zvakagadzirwa zvinouyawo. Zvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: MuTasks.org, vhura Settings, Backups usarudze Export tasks, wozoisa zviri mufaira re.json iroro. Marondedzero anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane zvinyorwa, matagi, mazuva, mhinduro nemabasa madiki; mabasa akapedzwa anochengeta zuva rawakapedzwa, uye kukosha kunova munda wakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namira zvabuda mu-task export: rondedzero ye-JSON kana basa rimwe pamutsara mumwe nomumwe. Mabasa apera anoenda ku-Done, project ne-priority zvinova mareberu, annotations inova mhinduro, uye depends inova kutsamira pamabasa anovhara.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: MuTeamwork.com, zadza tembureti yeExcel yekupinza mabasa (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) woichengetedza se.xlsx, wozosarudza faira iroro. Marondedzero emabasa anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi; basa rinotanga ne -, # kana > rinova basa diki rebasa riri pamusoro paro (--, ## kana >> danho rimwe pasi). Vapiwa basa, mazuva nematagi zvinoramba zviri munzvimbo dzazvo; Priority, Estimated time neComplete zvinova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: MuTickTick, vhura Settings, Account, Backup & Import wogadzira backup, wozoisa faira reCSV. Rondedzero yega yega yeTickTick inova mugwagwa uye makoramu ayo anova marondedzero; mabasa anochengeta matagi, mazuva, rondedzero yekuongorora, kukosha nemabasa madiki.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namira faira retodo.txt: basa rimwe pamutsetse, sezvinonyorwa neapp yetodo.txt nemaapp anoenderana nayo. Mabasa apera ("x") anoenda kuDone, +project na@context zvinova zvinyorwa, (A) inova chinyorwa chekutanga kukosha, uye due: na t: zvinova zuva rekupedzisira nezuva rekutanga zvichitevedzana.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: MuVikunja, vhura Settings, sarudza Data Export wotora faira re.zip rarinokutumira, wozosarudza faira iroro, kana isa data.json iri mukati maro. Mabhaketi eKanban anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane mareberu, vapiwa basa, mazuva, tsanangudzo, marondedzero emabasa semarondedzero ekuongorora nemhinduro; kukosha, chikamu chakaitwa uye kuitwa zvinova minda yakagadzirwa. Zvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-wrike: MuWrike, budisa purojekiti kana folda kuExcel, kana zadza tembureti yekupinza Excel yeWrike, wozosarudza faira re.xlsx iroro. Mitsara yemafolda nemapurojekiti inova migwagwa, Status inova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane Key, basa guru, vapiwa basa, mazuva ekutanga nekupedzisira, kuvimbana netsanangudzo; Priority, Duration nemamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Paste a ZenKit rondedzero tumira kunze JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages become rondedzero uye items become makadhi.
import-file-label: Sarudza faira rekubudisa, kana isa mavara aro pasi apa:
import-here-instruction: pinza a WeKan tumira kunze (.json kana .zip) here:
import-members-map: yako zvapinzwa bhodhi has some nhengo. Please map the nhengo you want ku pinza ku yako vashandisi
import-members-map-note: Note: Unmapped nhengo will iva assigned ku the yazvino mushandisi.
import-members-mode-map: Sarudza mushandisi aripo kune mumwe nemumwe wavo
import-members-mode-placeholder: Vachengete sevashandisi vechinguvana vane mazita avo, kuti vazoenderaniswa nevashandisi chaivo gare gare
import-not-wekan-export: That faira iri kwete a WeKan tumira kunze
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Mugwagwa wega wega waizogadzirwa nekupinza (purojekiti, folda kana rondedzero yechishandiso) unova bhodhi rawo. Makadhi makuru nekuvimbana pakati pemabhodhi iwayo zvinonyorwa mumushumo wekupinza.
import-report-description: Bhodhi ragadzirwa, asi zvimwe zvikamu zvefaira hazvina kukwanisa kupinzwa. Mushumo mumwe chete unochengetwa muPaneru yemutarisiri → Matambudziko → Kudzoreredza.
import-too-large: Faira yakakura zvakanyanya kuti ipinzwe kamwe chete. Iparadzanise kuita mafaira madiki, semuenzaniso nepurojekiti kana nezuva, wobva wapinza rimwe nerimwe.
instance-desc: Mushandisi wese akapinda muWeKan ino anogona kuona bhodhi iri. Harimboratidzwi kuvanhu vasina kupinda. Vanhu vakawedzerwa kubhodhi chete ndivo vanogona kurigadzirisa.
just-invited: You vari just invited ku bhodhi iri
list-permissions-desc: Izvo basa rimwe nerimwe rinogona kuita murondedzero iri, pamusoro pezvinobvumirwa nebhodhi. Vakuru vebhodhi vanogona kugadzirisa nguva dzose.
list-select-cards: sarudza zvose makadhi mu this rondedzero
muted-info: You will never iva notified ye chero shanduko mu bhodhi iri
name: Zita
notification-delivery-grouping-all: Zvese zvakakwana nguva mumeseji imwe chete
notification-delivery-layout-clear: Zvakarongeka zvakajeka: bhodhi, ani, kadhi nemavara makobvu

r-vars-people-hint: Zvakare: {creator}, {assignees}, {members} (mazita evashandisi mumavara, kero dzetsamba dzemagetsi mumunda weanogamuchira) uye {customField:Field name}. Izvi zvinoshandawo mumazita enhengo, rondedzero nemitsetse yekuronga mabasa mune zvimwe zviito.

r-workflow-help: Drag a trigger uye an chiito into the builder, then wedzera the rule. Drag an chiito onto an existing rule ku chinja what it does.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Maitiro ebasa eWrike irondedzero yemamiriro, rimwe nerimwe riri muboka reActive, Completed, Deferred kana Cancelled. Kubudisa kunonyora marondedzero ebhodhi rino semaitiro mamwe, akatumidzwa zita rebhodhi, muJSON inodzoswa neAPI yeWrike yemaitiro ebasa: gadzira maitiro iwayo muWrike usati wapinza kubudisa kweExcel kweWrike kwebhodhi, kuti mamiriro awo ashandiswe. Kupinza kunoverenga JSON iyoyo yaiswa pamusoro apa, kubva kuWeKan kana kuGET /workflows yeWrike, mubhodhi rakasarudzwa: mamiriro asina rondedzero anova rondedzero, uye mutemo unoratidza kadhi serakapedzwa kana rafambiswa kumamiriro eCompleted kana Cancelled uye risina kupedzwa muActive kana Deferred. Mitemo yeWrike yekuzviitira yega haigone kubudiswa kubva kuWrike.
recovery-no-events: kwete recovery events recorded. The database iri healthy.
recovery-report-desc: Automatic data-safety uye remediation zviito: corruption detection, text-data backups, restores, re-migration kubva MongoDB, uye automatic repair ye a bloated database.
submit-on-enter-description: When pa, pressing Enter saves the kadhi musoro, tsananguro uye zvimwe inline editors; Shift+Enter inserts a itsva line. When off, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves uye Enter inserts a itsva line.
text-contains-trigger-description: Inoenderana kana kadhi richigadzirwa, kana musoro kana tsanangudzo yacho ichishandurwa, uye mazwi matsva aine izvi (asina musiyano wemavara makuru nemadiki).
